component_id.format: lowercase kebab-case, globally unique across all four libraries
component_id.meaning: Persistent capability identity, independent of directory, version, company, model or agent nickname
component_id.collision: Prefix a new colliding identity by its kind; never silently rename a released identity.

reference.hash_format: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters generated from canonical relative component file membership and actual bytes
forbidden: latest alias in an execution plan

node_id.meaning: Stable semantic work identity within a plan lineage; preserve across revisions while goal and output meaning remain the same.
node_id.new_identity: Split, merge or changed economic scope receives new ids and supersedes links.
node_id.attempt: Attempt/version identity is engine-issued and distinct from node id; never reuse old attempt tokens on new inputs.

criteria_id.meaning: Stable human-approved acceptance criterion; revisions carry old/new content hashes, approval evidence and affected nodes.
criteria_id.authority: Explicit human approval only; model-authored critique is not authority to weaken a criterion.

other_ids.source: Separate source logical identity from immutable snapshot identity. A changed download is a new snapshot.
other_ids.finding: Stable issue id with original reviewer and artifact/attempt binding; new closure evidence never overwrites the finding.
other_ids.case: Development case id plus version. A changed expected behavior requires version bump; never relabel development material heldout.

versioning.content_change: Change component version when material semantics or resources change; any byte change changes its reference hash. Never alter bytes under an installed pinned release.
versioning.production: Only engine-owned evaluation and actual review evidence can authorize a quality-verified release.
